title: A Spider Spits Glue at 60 mph and Pins Its Prey in a Zigzag

scenes.text: This spider spits glue at over sixty miles an hour.
It's called the spitting spider. Its venomous glue shoots out of its fangs.
The whole spit takes under thirty milliseconds.
Its fangs vibrate up to eighteen hundred times a second, flicking the glue into a zigzag.
As the strands land, they shrink by about half and tighten around the victim.
So yes: over sixty miles an hour, from a spider.

description:
The spitting spider shoots venomous glue from its fangs at a peak of about 28.8 meters per second, over 60 mph.
The spit lasts under 30 milliseconds, and the strands shrink by about half to pin the prey.
Would you rather fight a spider or a snake?
first_comment: Spider or snake: which animal freaks you out more?
